_comment: cloud-ci-hub-exclusivity policy (DATA). Hub path enumeration lives ONLY at specs/integ-branch-envelopes.json#hubs.paths — this pack cites the pointer and MUST NOT re-list. Live producer (oya-cloud-ci-hub-exclusivity) loads hubs from that pointer and supplies open integ PR file facts (fixture or GitHub REST); the Rust evaluator REFUSEs multi-own. Wired into oya-ci-required affected-set admission. Born under ci/facade/affected-target-set to avoid Cargo.lock hub churn + registry/catalog adjunct (new package would require both).

product_contract.fail_closed: Empty hub authority, pointer mismatch, gate_id mismatch, or multi-owned hub => Verdict::Refuse (mechanical REFUSE).
product_contract.born_pack_shaped: Hub list is never hardcoded; authority is the envelopes JSON pointer. Open-PR facts are producer DATA.
product_contract.scope: Only head refs with integ_head_ref_prefix participate; non-integ PRs cannot satisfy or violate sole-owner.
